rung_purposes.purpose: Initialize ST20 pressure thresholds and test limits.
Detect PT-2001 wire break fault condition.
Detect ST20 pack overpressure alarm condition.
Detect ST20 supply air low alarm while station is busy.
Reset ST20 alarm flags via fault reset pushbutton.
Aggregate ST20 faults (including E-stop loss) and drive fault beacon.
Manual vent valve control when not in auto mode.
Start ST20 auto cycle, set busy flag, and clear previous results.
Transition from CLAMP to FILL step when clamp is fully closed.
Run ST20 fill step timeout timer.
Trigger fill timeout alarm if fill step timer completes.
Transition from FILL to STABILIZE step when fill pressure is reached.
Run ST20 stabilize step timer.
Capture test start pressure upon test window timer completion.
Transition from STABILIZE to TEST step when timer completes.
Run ST20 pressure decay test window timer.
Capture test end pressure and calculate pressure drop.
Evaluate PASS/FAIL result by comparing pressure drop to max allowed limit.
Transition from TEST to VENT step when test window timer completes.
Abort cycle to VENT step and force FAIL result upon general fault.
Run ST20 vent step timer.
Transition from VENT to UNCLAMP step when vented and safe.
Transition from UNCLAMP to COMPLETE step when clamp is open.
Clear busy flag and COMPLETE step when pallet leaves test position.
Energize clamp close solenoid during active cycle steps.
Energize fill valve during FILL step if no fault is active.
Energize vent valve during VENT step or upon overpressure.
Output PASS/FAIL signals to line controller during COMPLETE step.
End of ST20 program.
